newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays firm in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays firm in thin trading.

text.p: London white sugar futures retained their earlier firmness in light afternoon activity as trade buying supported positions across the board, market sources said on Thursday. Some March/May interest was cited earlier in the session to boost the flagging volume but then one leading trade house was reported to have been buying positions outright.

But volume stayed thin, reflecting the lack of activity towards the end of London's Sugar Week. At 1550 GMT overall turnover reached an exceedingly light 323 lots. December was $1.40 higher at $317.60 and March up $1.50 at $315.00. All positions gained ground. Paris positions were slightly firmer in a total volume of 268 lots. December was up $2.00 at $317.60 and March up $1.70 at $315.30. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
